messages:
incident-bot: PAGED Maya — high TPM anomaly detected for model-family="tessera-13b" (P95 latency stable, token drop rate rising). auto-threshold triggered.
Maya (oncall): oncall here, seeing customer errors on /v1/chat for tessera-13b, spike ~3x sustained over 2m. tagging eng-runtime + sre.
Sam (eng-runtime): looking now, traces show long queuing in runtime shards serving tessera-13b, KV cache miss rate up. probable bursty traffic from a single key.
Maya (oncall): initial mitigation proposal: apply temporary per-model soft cap and disable function-calling for tessera-13b to reduce token churn. Lia, any customer-facing impact?
Lia (support): one affected customer reported latency timeouts and degraded quality, they're on dedicated plan but ok with short mitigation if we announce. I'll message them.
Jeremy (sre): agree. suggest: 1) set TPM down from 12k -> 2k for tessera-13b 2) keep RPM at 600 for interactive use 3) add route fallback to tessera-7b-compat variant for canary traffic.
Sam (eng-runtime): can do the config patch. Will also enable throttling bucket per-key and enable soft-queue-drop for high-length requests. applying now.
Sam (eng-runtime): patch sent:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/admin/rate_limit" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"model_family":"tessera-13b","tpm":2000,"rpm":600,"soft":true,"reason":"emergency-surge-3532101234"}'
```
Maya (oncall): ops-bot, please run the rollout and notify on success.
ops-bot: acknowledged. initiating rollout to edge-proxies and gateway layer. expected 45s to 2m for global convergence.
ops-bot: rollout complete in us-west-2/us-east-1/eu-west-1. rate changes active.
Sam (eng-runtime): also pushed feature-toggle to disable function-calling for tessera-13b:
```
PATCH /api/flags
{ "flag": "model.feature.funcall", "model": "tessera-13b", "enabled": false, "note": "emergency-mitigation-3532101234" }
```
Maya (oncall): monitoring metrics — token throughput dropped ~68%, queue depth halved, P95 latency improved slightly. customer-reported timeouts reduced.
Lia (support): notified affected customer; they confirmed errors subsided and appreciate heads-up.
Jeremy (sre): plan for next 30m: observe KPIs, if stable raise TPM to 4k in staged increments, re-enable funcall only after we see sustained KV hit-rate improvement. also create an incident follow-up ticket.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Jeremy for longer monitoring window. I'm back on rotation duty. @Jeremy take over incident channel.
Jeremy (sre): taking over. will run warmup for tessera-13b cache and throttle suspect API key if we see repeat bursts. adding action items:
- throttle abusive key if persists
- add short-term customer rate recommendations
- postmortem draft (incl. root cause investigation)
Maya (oncall): thanks — ping me if you need escalation. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged as "model-traffic-surge-3532101234" assigned to Jeremy (sre).
